findings.message: TC-AUTH-001 authenticates as warehouse_operator, while REQ-AUTH-001 permits approval only for sales_manager. The successful approval oracle is unsupported for the supplied actor and requires an authorization behavior decision before this case can be accepted.
evidence: TC-AUTH-001.steps[0].expected_result=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
